confidence_notes: The food and drink anchors are based on web searches done for this estimate. Those searches found 2026 crowdsourced cost-of-living figures: an inexpensive meal at about EUR 10 (typical range EUR 8-15), a cappuccino at about EUR 2.50-3.10 and a domestic draft beer at about EUR 2.55. They also found a guide listing a glass of wine at about EUR 4.50 and cocktails at about EUR 8-12 in regular bars, with rooftop bars charging more. These sources are crowdsourced, AI-assisted or guide-based, so treat the figures as approximate. Euro amounts were converted to USD at about 1.10 USD per EUR. That rate is implied by the RBA's 18 Nov 2026 rates (0.6720 USD and 0.6115 EUR per AUD). The beer, coffee and meal figures were rounded up slightly for July 2026 prices and peak-season tourist demand in the Old Town. The mid-range meal for two is a model estimate of about EUR 50, scaled from the inexpensive-meal price. The cocktail figure leans toward ordinary bars rather than rooftop venues. All four accommodation anchors are model estimates from general knowledge for July peak season. They were not checked against live listings and are the least certain anchors.
comparable_city_reasoning: Bratislava's prices are similar to other Central European capitals and secondary cities, such as Brno, Budapest and Ljubljana. They are well below nearby Vienna. Accommodation was benchmarked against typical Central European summer rates for a smaller capital with steady weekend and river-cruise tourism.
